message: Vector Rebel 3.2.72: sort swing names by surname, compare Captain check red Xs to verified Scout attendance with captain review, and learn real read durations for an item-count countdown.
releaseNotes: Daily Captain Check: + Add Swing now sorts by last name (First Last and Last, First). After the report loads, the administrator-linked Rebel Command device makes a bounded authenticated read-only request to Scout/CrewSense staffing observations for each completed C-shift day. The report offers suggested historical full-tour OFF or other-crew exceptions only when source rows explicitly document both days as full 24-hour leave or full assignments to another apparatus. The captain must review and confirm the exact two-day attendance before any PPE red X is excused. Missing staff rows, partial fragments, stale/partial captures, conflicting evidence and non-administrator pairings remain unknown; no inspection is fabricated and no CrewSense writing occurs. An expandable person/day evidence summary shows source status. Daily Captain PPE audits now measure actual native history-read durations by inspection mode (ordinary PPE versus SCBA), maintain bounded median timings locally with no personnel identifiers, display a compact live elapsed/progress/remaining-time estimate across page changes, and show a pre-run estimate only when previous inventory and learned durations cover every selected person. Until such timing evidence exists, the ETA says learning rather than inventing a number. Original SCBA 3.2.71 queues and all confirmation gates remain compatible.
